repro: Open https://amora.regencivics.earth/ signed out and scroll to 'Four unique journeys'. All four cards show a grey gradient and the broken-image alt text spilling over the card top-left corner. All four sources are amora.cr/wp-content/uploads/... and all four return 404; the host root returns 200.
personaLine: The four ways into this village are grey boxes with the word Investor floating off the corner. I assumed the site was half-built and closed the tab.

elementChain: the value beside the moon in the How it landed card, and the same string on the rail card
repro: On a local build with governance public: open an advisory ballot, vote No as the only voter, close it. The summary strip reads 'Agreement 0% of 80%'; the panel forty pixels below reads 'Agreement - none yet'; the caption under it reads 'Agreement is below the 80% this vote needs. 0 yes, 1 no.' The rail card shows 'Agreement / none yet' directly above 'You voted no'.
personaLine: I voted no, the village closed the vote on my no, and the record tells me nobody ever took a side.

viewport: 1280x800 loses parts of words; 390x844 loses whole words
elementChain: outer ring labels of the doughnut inside div.bg-card.border.border-border
repro: Open /village-health at 390 wide. The left and right outer doughnut labels render as 'ed / ate' and 'He / 0 t'. At 1280 they read 'otected / s to date' and 'Hectare / 0 ha to d', and 'Food produced' is cut by the card bottom edge. The DOM carries the full strings, so text and contrast assertions all pass.
personaLine: Two of the land's six measurements are labelled 'ed' and 'He'.

elementChain: the gate card; the page's only a[href] points at /admin
repro: Open https://amora.regencivics.earth/project-history signed out. Tab title 'What we have built', card heading 'Journey to Launch', one link on the whole page (/admin), no header, no footer. /admin signed out then has linkCount 0 and is not scrollable. Compare /journey-to-launch, which shows the same gate inside the full site shell with 46 links.
personaLine: Somebody sent me a link to what the village has built, and two taps later I was on a login form with no way back.

category: an instruction that cannot be followed
elementChain: the module-off card under the 'Start a proposal' heading
repro: Open /propose signed out on live. Under 'Start a proposal' it reads: 'Amora hasn't enabled this module. Reach out to the admin team, or make a proposal to initiate it in your village.' The remedy offered is the page being refused, to a reader with no account and no village.
personaLine: It told me to make a proposal. That is the page I was on, and it was closed.

category: a raw id where a name belongs
elementChain: monospace pills inside the 'Your Progression' card
repro: Register an ordinary member on a local build and open /profile. 'Your Progression' shows eleven dotted keys as pills (forum.post, map.viewPeople, map.contact, map.photograph, stay.member_rate, exchange.buy, exchange.swap, message.send, mechanics.propose, event.rsvp, ballot.vote) directly above the sentence 'Your stage turns will be recorded here. Each one names what it unlocked.'
personaLine: My profile says it will name what I unlocked, then shows me stay.member_rate.

elementChain: the page intro paragraph, and the holder line on a power card
repro: On a local build move a capability to a role with no seat holder, then open /powers as a member. The intro says 'Every power here has somebody behind it ... This page says which is which, and who to ask.' The card then says 'Founders Circle holds this, and nobody is sitting there yet.' No onward step is offered.
personaLine: It promised to tell me who to ask, then told me nobody is there.

elementChain: the banner above the outcome badge
repro: Close an advisory ballot and open its page. Above the DID NOT CARRY badge the banner still reads 'The village is being asked, and nothing more' and 'closing it changes nothing on its own', in the present tense. The rail uses the past tense for the same ballot.
personaLine: The page says the village is being asked, under a badge saying the vote already failed.

repro: Open /profile signed out from the footer link on any public page. The tab reads 'Sign in - Amora' and the h1 reads 'Welcome Back'.
personaLine: It welcomed me back and I had never been here.

elementChain: governance health card, season card, seats card
repro: Open /village-health. It reads '0 decision(s) opened by 0 member(s).', '23 day(s) left', '16 seat(s) have nobody on them at all.'
personaLine: The village's own health page talks to me in form-field grammar.

elementChain: the 'How much the village turns out' card
repro: Close four ballots at 50%, 0%, 0% (withdrawn) and 50% turnout. The card reads 'Across 4 closed votes, an average of 25% of the village's weight has spoken.' The withdrawn ballot is counted as a 0% turnout.
personaLine: A vote we called off is being counted against our turnout.
